contradictions_found.contradicting_source: MMB Health Trends 2025 Global PDF (multiple cached copies)
contradictions_found.contradicting_data: Indonesia 2023 actual medical trend rate = 14.6%, not 13.6%
contradictions_found.explanation: The 13.6% figure appears to originate from a PMC academic paper (pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12425502/) which cited 'Medical cost inflation by MMB' for 2023 as 13.60%. This PMC paper used 13.6% as a comparator for a retiree population study. The MMB Health Trends 2025 report itself (the primary source) shows Indonesia 2023 actual = 14.6%.

contradictions_found.contradicting_data: MMB forecasts Indonesia 2024 = 17.9%, substantially above the 14-16% range
contradictions_found.explanation: Two distinct MMB products are involved. The 'Indonesia Health and Benefits Study 2024' (survey of 470+ Indonesian companies) projected 14.6% medical inflation for 2024. The 'MMB Health Trends 2025' global insurer survey showed a 17.9% forecast for Indonesia in 2024. These are methodologically different surveys. Aon shows 13.1% actual for 2024 (different methodology, different insurer panel).

The 16-19% range brackets MMB's 19.0% on the high end and Aon's 16.2% forecast on the low end. However Aon's revised 2025 actual (from the 2026 report) is only 13.0%, suggesting actual realized trend may have come in lower than forecast.
